Multiply every row by a matrix from a second table.

The Matrix input's number columns are the outputs; its rows weigh the data's columns, in order, or as its text column names them (a matrix exported from Tools > Linear Algebra or another run's loadings). The Matrix table is a parameter of this step, not training rows. Outputs Float32 columns named after the matrix's (with Prefix) alone, with the label as y and the split carried, or beside the input with Keep columns.

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Columns | Feature columns | `feature_cols` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated data columns, one per matrix row; empty: every number column but the label (or the matrix's names) |
| Columns | Label column | `label_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Optional label column passed through as y. |
|   | Prefix | `prefix` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Put before each output column's name. |
|   | keep_columns | `keep_columns` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Keep the input columns and add the outputs beside them. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
